weeks.topic: Regional Geography of Nigeria: Relief and Drainage Basins
subtopics: Fundamental definitions and principles of Regional Geography of Nigeria: Relief and Drainage Basins
Classroom demonstrations and worked standard problems in Geography
Nigerian practical application, industrial relevance, and continuous evaluation drill
learningObjectives: Explain the physical, climatic, and cartographic principles governing Regional Geography of Nigeria: Relief and Drainage Basins (Bloom: Remember & Understand).
Interpret topographical survey maps, contour lines, and scale conversions with accurate spatial calculations (Bloom: Apply & Calculate).
Analyze the spatial distribution of Nigerian drainage basins, mineral deposits, or settlement patterns (Bloom: Analyze & Evaluate).
Draw and label self-explanatory geographical sketch maps and hydrological diagrams according to WAEC/NECO conventions.
weeks.statutoryCompetency: NERDC National e-Curriculum — Terminal Mastery Standard
